conventions: All code in headers — no .cpp except main.cpp and test files
Namespace nn (NaturalNumbers) for all library code
namespace tlsf for the TLSF allocator (completely separate from nn)
MIT license header in every file
TEST(name, expr) macro for unit tests (fprintf-based, not a framework)
Header-only globals (nn_izero, nn_ione, stat_* counters) — each test TU must be separate CMake target
normalize(how=3): bit1=trim trailing zero bits, bit2=GCD reduce

hard: All code remains in headers — no .cpp files except main and tests
Must pass all existing tests (test_integer, test_numeric) with zero behavioral changes
Thread pool is always-on when concurrency > 1
MIT license header must be preserved in every file
TLSF allocator must remain a singleton via TLSF_Impl
soft: Academic commentary is additive — no algorithm changes
Minimal diffs: prefer targeted edits over full rewrites
Keep #pragma GCC optimize guards around performance-critical sections (isal/isar)
Keep existing fast paths (small-integer special cases in operator*)
compatibility: C++17 minimum compatibility for downstream users (but build targets C++23)
Windows (MSVC, _WIN32) paths must still compile — guarded by #ifdef
g++ and MSVC both supported for TLSF bitops

patterns: Header-only include DAG: tlsf.hpp → id.hpp → wk.hpp → ii.hpp → nn.hpp → main.cpp
Ref-counted bigint via nn_integer_data (proxy pattern with add_ref/release)
TLSF allocator singleton for bigint memory (custom malloc/free for fragmentation control)
Thread pool (ThreadPoolT) for parallel bigint multiplication
Rational arithmetic via integer numerator/denominator pairs
π via BBP formula (Bailey-Borwein-Plouffe) with iterative refinement
sin/cos/atan via Taylor series with factorial caching
sqrt via Newton's method (exact rational) — WARNING: fraction blowup

gotchas.text: Newton fraction blowup: numeric::root(power=2, iter) creates million-bit integers at iter=20. Keep iter <= 12.
Header-only globals cause linker errors if multiple TUs include id.hpp/ii.hpp. Each test must be separate CMake target.
String constructor had negative bug: numeric("-3.14159") gave -2.85841. Fixed by subtracting fraction when ipart.is_neg().
integer + numeric converts numeric -> integer via truncation (numerator/denominator). Always wrap as numeric to stay rational.
normalize(how=3): bit1=trim trailing zero bits, bit2=GCD reduce. normalize(1) skips GCD. normalize(3) after arithmetic.
div() method on integer shadows std::div from <cstdlib> — rename needed.

prior_decisions.decision: Keep C++17 as minimum compatibility baseline despite targeting C++23
rationale: Downstream users may not have C++23 compilers
C++23 features are additive (guarded by __has_include/if consteval)

prior_decisions.decision: Add but do not restructure — preserve all algorithm implementations
rationale: Academic commentary should explain, not change behavior
Existing tests validate correctness; changing algorithms invalidates tests

prior_decisions.decision: Use reinterpret_cast for pointer type-punning where std::bit_cast is insufficient (different pointer sizes)
rationale: std::bit_cast requires same size; word* vs dword* may differ
reinterpret_cast followed by dereference is equivalent to current union behavior
